_about: v2.2 Neutral rework, unit N1 (corrective pass, Oct 12) — the REVIEWED edits that give the ACCEPTED draw engine the N1 pool. The engine is `Sparkforge/Systems/UpgradeManager.swift` as committed at the pinned commit (the legacy pool lives inside it), kept as the FROZEN copy `frozenCopy` beside the fixtures (immutable like them; byte-identical to git, which run.sh re-checks whenever git can show the commit); run.sh refuses it unless its SHA-256 equals `engineSHA256`, applies these exact-once string edits, and builds the comparator from it. The comparator's transcript of the 22 legacy runs is what the current catalog-backed manager's replay must equal byte for byte (JF2b). Unedited, the same engine must reproduce the frozen legacy run fixture byte for byte (JF2b-0). The edits change only the three cards the overlay names: Keen Eye leaves the pool; Swift and Magnetic Core get the overlay's three-tier ladders, written as the same expressions the registry uses so the doubles are identical. Moving the engine (a different commit or hash) or changing an edit is a ruling, never a drive-by.

edits.name: Swift: the overlay's three-tier ladder (totals 0.08 / 0.20 / 0.35)
Keen Eye: retired (leaves the pool in place)
Magnetic Core: the overlay's three-tier ladder (radius totals 0.15 / 0.30 / 0.50; burst set to 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30)
edits.replace:
id: "v13_magnetic_core", name: "Magnetic Core", tag: .neutral,
            description: "+15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst",
            apply: { stats in
                stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.15
                stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.10
            },
            higherTiers: [
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.30 - 0.15
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.20
                },
                { stats in
                    stats.pickupRadiusMultiplier += 0.50 - 0.30
                    stats.magneticCoreSpeedBoost = 0.30
                }
            ]
        ))
